description: The portfolio's Renovate configuration lives in sborka and is extended by name. What was here before was `config:recommended` and nothing else, and #42 and #43 are what that costs: one sborka release, 0.2.0.29, arriving as two pull requests. The version is named in settings.gradle.kts and again in the catalog, and only a grouping rule makes them one change.

Two visible changes beyond the groups: updates now arrive as one Monday batch rather than a trickle, and pull request titles become Conventional Commits (`chore(deps):` / `fix(deps):`) because the preset enables `semanticCommits`.

Automerge is a separate preset (`github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness`) and is not extended here: nothing merges itself in this repository today. Its precondition holds — build.yml runs on `pull_request` — so it can be added as its own change.
